title: Rare Vintage Kodak Disc 4100 Camera Made In USA Eastman Kodak Company -Untested
categoryName: Cameras & Photo:Vintage Movie & Photography:Vintage Cameras:Disc Cameras
descriptionText: The Rare Vintage Kodak Disc 4100 Camera is a nostalgic piece of photography history manufactured by Eastman Kodak Company in the USA. This multi-color camera model, known as the KODAK 4100, captures the charm and quality synonymous with vintage cameras. Made in the United States, this disc camera offers a glimpse into the past with its unique design and brand association with Kodak, a trusted name in the industry. Ideal for collectors or photography enthusiasts looking for a piece of American-made craftsmanship.
